services.desc: After reviewing our camps below, click the Program Notes and FAQ buttons above get a full overview of our programs. Get ready for strange and unusual fun with Beetlejuice Jr. In this hilariously spooky camp, students explore bold physical theatre, quick comedy, and big musical numbers as they bring this beloved story to life. With over-the-top characters, supernatural antics, and high-energy ensemble work, campers develop confidence and creativity in a wildly supportive environment. By the final performance, they’ll deliver a show that’s funny, chaotic, heartfelt - and totally unforgettable.
